injuries.name: James Conner
injuries.note: Conner (foot) is close to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

injuries.name: Blake Grupe
injuries.note: The Rams placed Grupe (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

injuries.name: Trent McDuffie
injuries.note: McDuffie (groin) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

injuries.name: Alaric Jackson
injuries.note: Jackson's suspension for an act of unsportsmanlike conduct during Monday's game versus the Bills has been reduced to one game, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injuries.name: Myles Garrett
injuries.note: Head coach Sean McVay told reporters Tuesday that Garrett (knee) will not return to practice this week and will not play against the Cardinals on Sunday, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.
